```{r}
complete_meta_dt <- read_excel(
  here::here("metadata/complete/brain_virome_metadata.v2.xlsx")
) |>
  mutate(
    sample_ID = case_when(
      Pool == "p1733" ~ Alt_ID2,
      Pool == "p1849" ~ Alt_ID2,
      Pool == "p1894" ~ gsub("_B", "_1B", Alt_ID2),
      TRUE ~ Barcode
      ),
    tissue = `Brain Region\r\n`
    )
```

Load and parse metadata
```{r}
meta_pil_dt <- read_excel(
  here::here("metadata/samples/brain_pilot_fmt_pools_metadata.xlsx")
) |>
  mutate(
    condition = case_when(
      grepl("-A", sample_ID) ~ "bulk DNA",
      grepl("-B", sample_ID) ~ "host depleted DNA",
      grepl("-C", sample_ID) ~ "bulk RNA",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(tissue = gsub("Brain tissue/", "", sample_description)) |>
  filter(condition %in% c("bulk DNA", "other")) #only look at hybrid capture DNA for this

meta_hvp_dt <- read_excel(
  here::here("metadata/samples/brain_hvp_fmt_pools_metadata.xlsx")
) |>
  mutate(tissue = gsub("Brain DNA - ", "", sample_description)) |>
  filter(note == "brain_dna_capture") #only look at hybrid capture DNA for this

meta_dt <- rbind(
  meta_pil_dt |> select(c(sample_ID, Pool, tissue)),
  meta_hvp_dt |> select(c(sample_ID, Pool, tissue))
) |>
  mutate(
    mlab2 = case_when(
      grepl("XX-0", sample_ID) ~ str_replace(sample_ID, "^([^-]*-[^-]*).*$", "\\1"),
      #grepl("HELTHY|MODAD|SEVAD", sample_ID) ~ gsub("-A$", "", sample_ID),
      TRUE ~ sample_ID
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!grepl("CMMR", sample_ID))
```

```{r}
meta_dt |> distinct(tissue)
```


```{r}
donor_meta_dt <- read_excel(
  here::here("metadata/donors/simple_donor_meta1.xlsx")
)

# The donor sheet has a few `join_col` keys that appear more than once and map to
# DIFFERENT patient_IDs/ages (ambiguous source data). Left unhandled, merge()
# would fan those sample rows out into duplicates. De-duplicate to keep the join
# 1:1 on join_col (keeping the first occurrence) and report the affected keys so
# they can be fixed upstream.
dup_join <- unique(donor_meta_dt$join_col[duplicated(donor_meta_dt$join_col)])
if (length(dup_join)) {
  message("Ambiguous donor join_col keys collapsed to first row: ",
          paste(dup_join, collapse = ", "))
}
donor_meta_dt <- donor_meta_dt |> distinct(join_col, .keep_all = TRUE)

all_old_meta_dt <- merge(
  meta_dt,
  donor_meta_dt,
  by.x = "mlab2",
  by.y = "join_col",
  all = T
) |>
  mutate(
    sample_ID = gsub("-A$", "", sample_ID),
    sample_ID = case_when(
      sample_ID == "SEVAD_BF5" ~ "SEVAD_2BF5",
      sample_ID == "SEVAD_BH5" ~ "SEVAD_1BO5",
      sample_ID == "SEVAD_BO5" ~ "SEVAD_1BO5",
      TRUE ~ sample_ID
    )
    )
```

```{r}
meta_merge1_dt <- merge(
  complete_meta_dt,
  all_old_meta_dt,
  by = c("sample_ID", "Pool")
) |>
  filter(
    !grepl("CMMR", sample_ID), # remove controls
    !grepl("-B$", sample_ID), # remove alternative conditions
    !grepl("-C$", sample_ID) # remove alternative conditions
    ) 
```

```{r}
meta_merge1_dt |>
  filter(Age != age_at_death)
```
